name: Kitchen and home appliance parts
meta_description: 3D-printed parts for fridges, dryers, dishwashers and vacuums: door bins, drawer wheels, knobs, clips, latches and triggers. Quote within 24 hours.
intro: When a plastic bin, wheel, knob, clip or trigger breaks, the appliance is often fine but the part is out of stock or sold only in a costly assembly. We print the plastic piece to order from your model number and photos, and we never make electrical or food-contact parts.
image_alt: Printed fridge door bin, dryer knob and dishwasher clips
